notes.title: IGF Win and LudoNarraCon Participation!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're very happy to announce that Mediterranea Inferno won the Excellence in Narrative Award and this year's Independent Games Festival! The award ceremony was held in San Francisco, you can see the team's acceptance speech here, at minute 54:42

[previewyoutube=WkW3FicsKUU;full][/previewyoutube]

It was a truly wonderful moment and we are incredibly honored for this achievement!

We also wanted to share that we are currently on sale as part of the LudoNarraCon happening right now on Steam, check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon There are panels, new demos, and lots of great narrative games on sale.

Speaking of which! Mediterranea Inferno is also part of this wonderful bundle with the other IGF finalists for Excellence in Narrative:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38427/Excellence_in_Narrative__IGF_2024/

If you liked our game, we very much recommend you check out these other titles!

That's all for now, thank you as always for your support!

Everybody take care,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: New Languages and IGF Nominations!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that Mediterranea Inferno is now playable in two more languages, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

Both translations have been executed with love and dedication to be as close as possible to the original material, and by the translators of the respective languages for Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.

We're also thrilled to share that the game has been nominated for three categories at the prestigious Independent Games Festival:

[list]
[*]Seumas McNally Grand Prize
[*]Nuovo Award
[*]Excellence in Narrative
[/list]
The award ceremony will be held on March 20th and you can also see it on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/gdc]Twitch[/url]. The game will be also on the expo floor at the Game Developers Conference 2024 (March 18-22) in San Francisco, the team will be in attendance, so come say hi! 

Everybody take care,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Out now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103680/Mediterranea_Inferno/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34152/Mediterranea_Inferno_Game__Soundtrack_Bundle/

It's here! Thank you everyone for your patience and support. I'm very happy to have had the chance to work on this project, I think Lorenzo (Mediterranea Inferno and Milky Way Prince's author) really outdid himself this time, creating a work that as visually captivating as it is poignant.

The team and I are looking forward to hearing what you think of it, and reviews on Steam really do help us reach a wider audience so remember to leave one after you finish Mediterranea Inferno!

The game is available with a 10% discount for the first week ($13.49) and a 25% discount if you get the soundtrack bundle. Speaking of which, it's an incredible 60+ minutes of bliss, and if you don't believe me you can preview it on [url=https://santaragione.bandcamp.com/album/mediterranea-inferno-original-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url].

Thank you again for your support! Until next time,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Launching August 24th!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

This is Pietro from Santa Ragione, I hope you are all enjoying the Steam Visual Novel Fest so far! 

We have some big news to share with you today! Mediterranea Inferno, our treacherous visual novel about friendship, desire, and grief set against the backdrop of the alluring South of Italy will launch on August 24th! 

[previewyoutube=h2VvkqZb8oU;full][/previewyoutube]

A demo covering the first chapter is available now on Steam, with save states carrying to the full game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103680/Mediterranea_Inferno/

The game lasts 3-4 hours on a first try. There are options to run the game faster and multiple save slots if you want to explore other branches on subsequent playthroughs. Also, a hidden ending is reached by... eh, better not to spoil too much.

Please remember to add Mediterranea Inferno to your wishlist (and ask your friends :D) because it does really help!

Thank you for your support, we can't wait to hear what you think of the game when it comes out in just TWO WEEKS!

Pietro and the team at SR
